Hello, community!

December is a good month to reflect on what we did, what are our plans for next
year, and to pick the real physical paper agenda you're going to use starting
next month... Isn't it? This month we're featuring stories about new funding
opportunities, new workshops, our end-of-year reflection and our wishes for 2027.

As always, if you have news, a project, or a question you'd like us to
feature, reply to this email or write to
[open_scholarship@sfu.ca](mailto:open_scholarship@sfu.ca).

Gracielle and the Open Scholarship team

## Featured story

::: {.feature image="images/feature.png" alt="Researchers reviewing a shared dataset together" link="https://www.sfu.ca/research/researcher-resources/further-my-research/knowledge-mobilization-hub/stories/2025/a-new-open-scholarship-movement.html"}
### A new open scholarship movement at SFU

SFU is the first university in Canada to adopt open scholarship for the whole
institution. Our Knowledge Mobilization Hub looks at what that commitment
means in practice, from open access publishing to community-engaged research,
and what's coming next.

[Read the story](https://www.sfu.ca/research/researcher-resources/further-my-research/knowledge-mobilization-hub/stories/2025/a-new-open-scholarship-movement.html){.button}
:::

## Upcoming events {.tinted}

::: {.event date="2026-11-18" time="10:00 to 11:30 a.m." place="Online (Zoom)"}
### Preparing your data for sharing

A practical session on file formats, documentation and choosing a repository.
Bring a dataset you're working on.

[Register](https://www.sfu.ca/research){.button .secondary}
:::

::: {.event date="2026-11-25" time="12:00 to 1:00 p.m." place="Burnaby campus, W.A.C. Bennett Library"}
### Preprint review club

Read and discuss a recent preprint together, then post a community review on
PREreview. No experience needed.

[Join the club](https://prereview.org/clubs/osi-sfu){.button .secondary}
:::

## Opportunities

::: highlight
#### Applications open: Open Scholarship Champions

Champions lead open projects in their units and get training, mentorship and
a small project budget. Faculty, staff and students are all welcome.
**Apply by December 5.**
:::

::: two-col
::: {.col image="images/card-1.png" alt="Starter plan checklist"}
#### Open Scholarship Starter Plan

A step-by-step plan for making your next project more open.

[Get the plan](https://www.sfu.ca/research/researcher-resources/further-my-research/open-scholarship/os-starter-plan.html)
:::

::: {.col image="images/card-2.png" alt="Calendar for booking a meeting"}
#### Book office hours

Talk through your project with our community manager, one to one.

[Book a time](https://cal.com/graciellehigino/sfu-os-office-hour)
:::
:::
